name: RadioCards
description: Selectable option cards that behave as a single radio group. The accent border springs from card to card and a check mark draws itself into the selected card's indicator.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern: role="radiogroup" labelled by the visible group label, each card is role="radio" with aria-checked and aria-describedby pointing to its description. Roving tabindex keeps a single Tab stop; Arrow keys move and select (wrapping, skipping disabled cards), Home/End jump to the ends, Space/Enter select. Disabled cards expose aria-disabled. Under prefers-reduced-motion the highlight and check change instantly.

propsApi.name: options
propsApi.type: { value: string; label: string; description?: string; meta?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

propsApi.name: defaultValue
propsApi.description: Initial selected value when uncontrolled (falls back to the second, then first option).

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the newly selected value.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Visible group label, used as the radiogroup's accessible name.

propsApi.name: columns
propsApi.description: Number of grid columns (1-4); collapses to one column on narrow screens.

propsApi.name: size
propsApi.description: Card padding and type size preset.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the highlight border, tint and check indicator.

propsApi.name: showDescriptions
propsApi.description: Show the description line of each option.

propsApi.name: slidingHighlight
propsApi.description: Spring the highlight border between cards; when false it fades in place.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
